name: Batch Converter
author: Lumen
description: Convert and resize images in batches in its own tab: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, GIF, TIFF and ICO from almost anything - including PSD, HEIC and camera RAW (Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fuji…). Animated GIF/WebP stay animated. Also lets File ▸ Open read HEIC, AVIF and RAW, and Save As write GIF, AVIF and ICO.
